The notice from May 2020 says the gas engine plant was planned to start in early 2022, which fits the stored start year of 2022. It gives only thermal input, 44.7 MW for two engines, which is not electric capacity, so the capacity of 20.5 MW is neither confirmed nor changed. The unit is already operating in GEM, so no status change is proposed.
